anchor.note: p.96 l.Lines 306-323 read as the printed page; section 4.3.3 agrees

public.text: Recommending FHIR as the primary exchange framework is reasonable for new health-data services, but the section may be read as recommending FHIR for every DPI-H domain and interaction, including supply chain, payments, geospatial data, trust, and bulk analytics.
public.suggestedRevision: State that FHIR is the recommended primary framework for relevant health-information exchange, while other recognised standards may be more appropriate for imaging, supply chain, payments, geospatial data, analytics, and foundational DPI integration.
